stem: A patient requested a partial fill of Dexedrine at this pharmacy 12 days after issue and returns for the documented balance on day 28. Which rule controls?

choices.text: Use the 72-hour rule for a pharmacy stock shortage.
Calculate 30 days from the date of the partial dispensing.
Send the balance to any pharmacy selected by the patient.
Dispense the documented remainder at the same pharmacy before the 30-day issue-date deadline.
Record the balance as an authorized refill of the Schedule II prescription.

explanation.core_reasoning: Dispense the documented remainder at the same pharmacy before the 30-day issue-date deadline. By contrast, 'Use the 72-hour rule for a pharmacy stock shortage.' uses a legal trigger absent from the stem.

choice_analysis.A: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Use the 72-hour rule for a pharmacy stock shortage.
choice_analysis.B: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Calculate 30 days from the date of the partial dispensing.
choice_analysis.C: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Send the balance to any pharmacy selected by the patient.
choice_analysis.D: The stated facts support this result: Dispense the documented remainder at the same pharmacy before the 30-day issue-date deadline.
choice_analysis.E: This near-miss uses a different trigger: Record the balance as an authorized refill of the Schedule II prescription.

related_facts: dextroamphetamine (Dexedrine) is used for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and narcolepsy; it is federal Schedule II and Massachusetts Schedule II.
Only the pharmacy that made the initial patient-requested Schedule II partial fill may dispense the remainder, and the remainder must be filled no later than 30 days after issue.
explanation.mpje_trap: Reject 'Use the 72-hour rule for a pharmacy stock shortage.' because its legal trigger is absent.

reasoning_steps: Classify dextroamphetamine under the federal and Massachusetts schedules before selecting a legal pathway
Match the scenario's operative facts to Massachusetts Schedule II patient-request remainder
